proposals.subtype: Adapt legacy core-client options, responses and errors to a REST-core operation
proposals.explanation: withLegacyOperationOptions bridges @azure/core-client options to an operation accepting @azure-rest/core-client options. Its converter merges customHeaders below explicit headers, removes shouldDeserialize from forwarded requestOptions and captures response/error callbacks. The wrapper chooses typed versus parsed-body results, invokes the legacy callback shape and normalizes eligible non-RestError failures with status >=300 into RestError with body details. In the captured-response/no-callback-error catch branch, disabled deserialization instead returns parsedBody. Supporting helpers are grouped with this single adapter.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The dedicated legacyOperationOptions module concretely bridges two different SDK core contracts, translating legacy customHeaders, shouldDeserialize and callback/error shapes rather than declaring protocol models. This purpose-built compatibility integration supports handwriting beyond missing headers or code complexity alone, though no emitted counterpart is supplied.

decisions.reason: The cited legacyOperationOptions.ts lines implement the described conversion of legacy request headers and deserialization options, response callbacks, and error normalization, and the five named functions occur within the cited ranges. The reusable adapter pattern is service-independent, but whether a generator could emit this compatibility bridge cannot be established from these excerpts alone. Most importantly, this file is marked with unknown provenance: its location under src/ and its specialized behavior do not establish that it differs from generated output, and no generated counterpart, generator manifest, or customization marker is supplied. It therefore cannot yet be accepted as genuinely handwritten customization.
